name: Kanraku no Arena ~In'yoku no Death Match~
original_name: 姦落のアリーナ 〜淫欲のデスマッチ〜
source: The protagonist, an aspiring physical trainer, is invited by the beauty of his academy he is secretly infatuated with, Hikawa Hitomi, to be her partner in the "DATEN" underground deathmatch arena where her defeat entails her rape in full view of the audience...
translation: 主角是一位有抱负的体能训练师，他受到自己暗恋的学院美女冰川瞳的邀请，成为她在“DATEN”地下死亡竞赛竞技场中的搭档，在那里她的失败导致她在众目睽睽之下被强奸……
